common.load_failed_body: Something went wrong on the way here. Your connection may have dropped, and trying again usually fixes it.
common.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

welcome.promise_body: Every feature is available to every person. Funded by donations, never by charging lonely people to be seen.

update.title: Update required
update.body: This version of {{appName}} is no longer supported. Update from your app store to carry on.

error.title: Something broke
error.body: This screen ran into an unexpected problem. Try again, and if it keeps happening it is our fault, not yours.

not_found.title: That page does not exist
not_found.body: The link may be out of date, or it may have been mistyped. Nothing is broken.

auth.no_password_explainer: No password. We email you a six digit code each time you sign in.
auth.verify_body: We sent a six digit code to {{email}}.
auth.code_resent: A new code is on its way.
auth.code_invalid: That code is not right, or it has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.email_invalid: That does not look like an email address.
auth.age_gate: You must be 18 or older to use {{appName}}.

onboarding.birthdate_body: This sets your age on your profile. We never show your date of birth to anyone.
onboarding.birthdate_invalid: That is not a real date.
onboarding.birthdate_too_young: You need to be {{age}} or older to use this app.
onboarding.birthdate_locked_warning: You cannot change this later, so please check it.
onboarding.about_you_body: Your name and a couple of lines. You can change all of this whenever you like.
onboarding.display_name_hint: This is what everyone sees. A first name is plenty.
onboarding.preferences_title: Who would you like to meet?
onboarding.preferences_body: We only show you people inside these limits, and only show you to them.
onboarding.preferences_changeable: You can change any of this in settings later.

profile.birthdate_locked: Set at signup and cannot be changed.
profile.verify_prompt: Verify your photo to appear in other people's decks.

home.not_visible_title: You are not in anyone's deck yet
home.location_body: We store it rounded to about a kilometre, and only ever show other people a rough distance.
home.location_denied: Location permission was refused. You can turn it on in your device settings.
home.next_body: Push notifications are next. Photos cannot go live until moderation is switched on, so profiles show initials for now.

photos.subtitle: Up to six. The first one is the one people see first, and you can reorder them any time.
photos.awaiting_review: Uploaded. It will appear once it has been reviewed.
photos.upload_failed: That photo could not be uploaded. Please try again.
photos.position_taken: That slot has just been filled. Pick an empty one.
photos.delete_failed: That photo could not be removed. Please try again.
photos.reorder_failed: That new order could not be saved. Your photos are still in the old order.
photos.limit_reached: You already have {{count}} photos. Remove one first.
photos.review_body: Every photo is checked before anyone can see it. Checking is not switched on in this build, so uploads stay unreviewed for now.

deck.empty_body: Try widening your distance or age range.
deck.widen_search: Adjust your distance and age range
deck.rate_limited: You have been swiping a lot. Take a short break and come back.

matches.title: Matches
matches.privacy_note: Only the two of you can read a conversation. Nobody at OpenHeart can, and there is no advertiser to sell it to.

chat.say_hello_body: Nobody has said anything yet. Someone has to go first.
chat.other_left: This person has deleted their account. Their messages stay here until you remove the conversation.
chat.long_press_hint: Tap or press and hold to react or remove
chat.unsend_too_late: This message has already been seen, so it stays.
chat.unsend_failed: That message could not be removed. Try again.
chat.rate_limited: You have sent a lot of messages in a short time. Try again shortly.
chat.unmatch_explainer: They will not be told. The conversation closes for both of you and neither can write again.
chat.hide_explainer: This only removes your copy. Their messages are their own and stay with them.
chat.reaction_failed: That reaction did not save. Try again.

safety.block_confirm: Block {{name}}? They will not be able to see you or message you.
safety.report_submitted: Thanks. Our team will review this.
safety.title: Report or block {{name}}
safety.menu_explainer: They are never told about either. Blocking also ends the conversation.
safety.detail_placeholder: Optional, but it helps a real person decide.
safety.report_done_body: A moderator reads every report. They will not be told who sent it.
safety.report_rate_limited: You have reported a lot of people just now. Try again shortly.
safety.evidence_note_one: The last message in this conversation is attached.
safety.evidence_note_other: The last {{count}} messages in this conversation are attached.
safety.block_explainer: They will not be told. The conversation ends and looks to them exactly like an unmatch.
safety.blocked_body: They cannot see you, message you, or appear in your deck. None of them know.
safety.unblock_explainer: Unblocking lets them appear in your deck again. It does not bring back a conversation that ended.
safety.report_done_contact: If it is urgent, write to {{email}}. If someone is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.language_restart: Close and reopen OpenHeart to finish switching. The text has changed already, but the layout has to be rebuilt to read right to left.
settings.delete_confirm: This permanently erases your name, photos and profile. It cannot be undone.
settings.delete_retains_messages: Messages you already sent stay in the other person's conversation, because they are their data too. Your name is removed from them.
settings.contact_body: Write to us about anything, including a safety concern. A person reads every message.

filters.title: Who you see
filters.body: Only people inside these limits appear in your deck, and you only appear in theirs.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.not_a_moderator: This queue is only for moderators.
moderation.empty: Nothing waiting. That is the good outcome.
moderation.note_placeholder: Why you decided this. Kept with the report.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: A moderator has suspended this account after a report. You cannot browse or message while it is suspended.
suspended.appeal: If you think this is wrong, reply to any email we have sent you and a person will read it.

verify.title: Verify your profile
verify.why: A quick selfie proves there is a real person here. It is the one thing that keeps this app free of bots and stolen photos, and nobody enters anyone else's deck without it.
verify.consent_compare: Your selfie is compared against the photos already on your profile, to check they are the same person.
verify.consent_deleted: It is deleted as soon as that check finishes. It never appears on your profile and nobody you match with ever sees it.
verify.consent_stored: No face data is kept. We store only whether the check passed.
verify.consent_human: If the check is unsure, one of our moderators looks at it rather than turning you away.
verify.needs_photos: Add at least one approved photo first. There is nothing to compare a selfie against yet.
verify.rate_limited: That is enough tries for today. Try again tomorrow.
verify.in_review: Your last attempt is with a moderator. You do not need to do anything.
verify.already_body: Nothing more to do. Your profile can appear in other people's decks.
verify.camera_body: Only for this selfie. It is not used anywhere else in the app.
verify.pose_turn_left: Turn your head to your left
verify.pose_turn_right: Turn your head to your right
verify.pose_hint: Hold it, keep your whole face in frame, then take the photo. We pick the direction so nobody can prepare one in advance.
verify.result_review: A person will look at this
verify.result_body_passed: Your profile can now appear in other people's decks. Your selfie has been deleted.
verify.result_body_review: The check was not certain, so a moderator will decide rather than turning you away. This usually takes a day. Your selfie is deleted once they have.
verify.result_body_rejected: Nothing was verified and your selfie has been deleted. You can try again.
verify.reason_no_face: No face was found in the photo.
verify.reason_multiple_faces: More than one face was in the photo. Take it on your own.
verify.reason_pose_mismatch: Your head was not turned the way we asked.
verify.reason_too_dark: It was too dark to see clearly. Try somewhere brighter.
verify.reason_too_blurry: The photo was too blurry. Hold still and try again.
verify.reason_sunglasses: Take your sunglasses off and try again.
verify.reason_low_confidence: We could not make out a face clearly enough.
verify.reason_no_match: The selfie did not clearly match your photos.
verify.reason_not_an_image: That file was not a photo we can read.
